summary: yield* delegates values from an inner synchronous iterator and yields each non-done IteratorResult.

target.notes: Uses GetIterator(sync), calls the inner next method initially with one explicit undefined argument, validates IteratorResults, and yields inner values until done.

tests.name: initial delegated next receives explicit undefined
tests.input: const inner={first:true,next(v){if(this.first){this.first=false;console.log(arguments.length,v===undefined);return {value:1,done:false}}return {done:true}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; function* g(){yield* inner} g().next();
